title: Goal
description: A canonical goal, at <venture>/foundation/goals/<id>.json: what the venture means to reach, by when, how anyone would know (measures with targets) and who owns it. Framework-neutral: the telos, ambition tiers, OKRs and other frameworks for thinking write goals through their maps_to and never change this shape (Torian, 2026-10-30: opinionated schema, swappable frameworks). Requirements derive from goals and measures; exit criteria serve measures.

kind.description: venture: the end the venture exists for. owner: what the owners intend once it is reached (hold, sell, list, wind down). scale: how far through the phases the venture means to go. product, function: a goal of one product or function. learning: what the venture must find out

horizon.description: The year it should be reached by, a date, a phase id, or 'open'

end_state.description: What is true in the world when it is reached

value.description: A goal's chosen value when its kind has a fixed set: the scale (hobby, survival, lifestyle, managed-growth, aggressive-growth) or the owner path (acquisition, ipo, secondary-sale, merger, management-buyout, wind-down, hold)

kind.description: A framework's own classification of the measure, kept as written

owner.description: The person or role who owns the goal

framework.description: The framework for thinking the goal was written through (frameworks/<id>), if any

conversation.description: The founder's messages this record was made from (naive diagnose catches)
